questionTextExtracted: Four men and 4 women can finish a piece of work jointly in 3 days while 2 men and 5 women can finish the same work jointly in 4 days. Find the time taken by one man alone and that of one woman alone to finish the same work by using matrix inversion method.
steps: Let m be the fraction of the work completed by one man in one day, and w the fraction completed by one woman in one day.
Four men and four women finish the work in three days, so 4m + 4w = 1/3.
Two men and five women finish the work in four days, so 2m + 5w = 1/4.
The determinant of A is 4×5 − 4×2 = 12, so A is invertible.
One man alone needs 18 days, and one woman alone needs 36 days.
